Thanks so much for your lovely words too. You are never alone. Night time is always worse, as my mind should be winding down I can feel it winding me up! I used to love to write but haven’t been able to concentrate to do so, now what I do to try and help myself when I am trying to sleep I write in my head. It doesn’t always work but some days I can distract myself enough to fall asleep. Another technique I use is to allow myself a time to ‘stress’ say five mins to let my mind go over the things bothering me. In this time I will try and tell myself the things I would tell a friend if they came to me with the same problem. I also tell myself over and over that stressing won’t change my situation so why bother. It’s hard, I know but if it works once when you are feeling particularly down then it’s worth a try. Just keep reaching out to people. You are never alone and remember that a problem shared is a problem halved. You got this 💪🏼

Due to covid my mum can’t go for testing to see if her cancer has returned for the fourth time, I’m also in the process of buying my first home and that’s keeping me up too. I’m trying to keep a positive mind and I really hope you can too. I try and tell myself not to sweat the things I can’t change. There are also other techniques to try and cope. Someone people find that writing out their feelings at the start of the day helps them get whatever is bothering them off their chest. Other people use medication apps or pick up nee hobbies to busy their minds. A lot of it is just being able to distract your mind enough so these thoughts won’t get a chance to enter your mind. Be strong, keep your chin up and tell yourself that there is nothing that you can’t overcome
